description: This source file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressive, batched processing of a large set of items. It enables UI applications to perform background work without blocking the main thread, leveraging requestIdleCallback when available. The core functionality includes creating a controller for batch processing, managing progress, and integrating with React component state.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches progressively, respecting time slices to keep UI responsive. Supports starting and canceling the process, and reports progress through callbacks.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that wraps the createProgressiveExpandController to manage stateful UI elements like running status, progress percentage, and counts, providing start and cancel controls.
